If you are a self-driven individual with a passion for connecting exceptional talent with rewarding career opportunities, we encourage you to apply.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
About HeyMax

HeyMax turns everyday spending into travel. Users earn Max Miles on the things they already buy, and redeem them for flights, hotels, and experiences worldwide. Founded in 2023, we're live in Singapore and Hong Kong - and building toward a product that works for anyone, anywhere in the world.
The role - a mini lab inside HeyMax

You'll run a growth and expansion design lab: a small, autonomous unit with one mandate - grow HeyMax 's user base, anywhere in the world. That means the full growth surface: how new users discover and activate, how existing users deepen and refer, and how the experience flexes for markets and users we haven't designed for yet. You operate like a startup within the startup - pick the highest-leverage problem, ship an experiment, read the data, decide what's next.
What you'll own

•
Global activation - the entire journey from first touch to first value moment, designed to work for any user in any market from day one. This is the engine that lets HeyMax launch a country without rebuilding the product.

•
One experience, every market - an adaptive design system where the product reconfigures itself around user state and market maturity. You're not designing screens per country; you're designing the rules that make one product serve a hundred markets.

•
Compounding growth loops - referral, sharing, and re-engagement mechanics built to scale across borders. Every experiment you ship becomes reusable infrastructure for the next market.

•
The lab's playbook - you set the growth agenda, run the experiment portfolio, and build the repeatable expansion playbook the whole company will run on.

Who you are

• 5+ years consumer product design, with real growth work - you've owned an activation or acquisition funnel metric, not just designed alongside one.

• Systems thinker: you design state machines, not screens. "What does this surface look like with 1 partner / 10 partners" is a question you ask before drawing anything.

• AI-native: AI tools are your default for prototyping, research synthesis, and copy variants - you move at lab speed because of it. Bonus: you've designed agent or copilot patterns.

• Comfortable with the ambiguity of a market you can't visit - you design research-cheap ways to learn (fake-door tests, concierge MVPs, remote unmoderated tests).

title: Solutions Architect - EMEA
description:
About Us

AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.

The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.

AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.

The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.

Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.

Software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. AI now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. Come build that future with us.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

title: Software Engineer, New Grad - Query Engines
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
We are a software engineering team applying open-source data technologies to some of the world's hardest and most important problems. We build the data processing infrastructure that underpins Palantir Foundry, supporting applications that help hospitals care for more patients, help clinical teams coordinate timely diagnoses, and keep essential supplies moving through global disruption.
 
You will work deep inside the systems that make this possible: how computations are represented, how query plans are optimised, how operators execute, and how data is read and written efficiently. We build on and extend Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, and Apache Iceberg, bringing advances in open-source engines and table formats into the demanding environments our customers operate in. Our work serves many products and workloads across Foundry, including no-code pipelines, interactive analysis, and the processing that keeps the Ontology up to date.
 
Working alongside experienced engineers, you will take on real problems in our production systems. That could mean writing a new planning rule, adding a capability to a native execution engine, or making large tables faster to scan. You will see your work through design, code review, testing, and release. Correctness, compatibility, and predictable performance are central to everything we build, and you will learn how to deliver all three.
 
Join us if you want to learn how modern data systems work from the inside and apply that knowledge to consequential problems.

Life at Palantir
 
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
 
If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.

title: Credit Risk Manager
description:
Who is Shift?

Shift provides business finance to small, established and corporate sized businesses in Australia, including Business Overdraft, Equipment Line, Asset Finance, Term Loan and Trade Account. Founded in 2014, Shift has funded more than 30,000 Australian businesses.

At Shift, our unique approach to product innovation combined with our collaborative culture means you can build your career in a supportive environment. You’ll be joining a diverse team of over 300 people who are always looking to deliver better outcomes for Australian businesses.

About the Role:

As Credit Risk Manager at Shift, you will be responsible for credit decisioning of escalated originations within our Small Business Division (SBD). With Delegated Lending Authority (DLA) up to $500K, you will handle scorecard referrals unresolved by Customer Solutions, focusing especially on at-the-margin cases that require judgment. This role is essential in delivering consistent, accountable credit standards and supporting SBD’s growth by consolidating credit decisioning under a single function.

As Shift further develops its digital and automated capabilities, your focus will evolve to include originations credit strategy, in-life (Continuous Credit) settings, and process and digital design, drawing on insights from hands-on decisioning.

What You’ll Do:

Credit Decisioning

- Decision escalated scorecard referrals outside standard rules, exercising DLA up to $500K.

- Own judgment-based decisions and applications just outside policy, approving, restructuring, or declining in line with risk appetite and credit policy.

- Deliver escalated referral decisions within agreed service standards, targeting under one business day turnaround.

- Act as the escalation point for complex or material credit cases across SBD.

Credit Standards & Strategy

- Set and document credit standards for at-the-margin cases, including complexity assessment.

- Progressively codify judgment-based decisions into policy and scorecard rules, reducing avoidable referrals.

- Refine SBD’s originations credit strategy using insights from escalated decisions.

- Input into continuous credit settings and participate in hindsight reviews of escalated decisions.

Data, Insights & Performance

- Establish, measure, and report monthly on service standards for escalated referrals.

- Track and report on escalation rates, turnaround times, and decision outcomes.

- Translate decision and portfolio data into actionable risk insights.

- Inform policy, scorecard, and process improvements based on exception and loss experience.

Decisioning Transition & Stakeholder Management

- Lead the transition of credit decisioning from Customer Solutions into SBD.

- Standardise escalation pathways for referred deals.

- Partner with the Customer Solutions Manager to optimise team capacity for customer and broker engagement.

- Represent credit decisioning across SBD Product, Technology, and Operations initiatives.

Process & Digital Design

- Provide credit input into digital experience design by leveraging direct decisioning experience.

- Identify manual controls and gaps in originations credit processes.

- Support standardisation of credit guidance and documentation.

- Ensure process changes are well-governed and operationally supported.

Skills & Experience:

- Strong understanding of credit risk principles, portfolio management, and risk appetite frameworks.

- Analytical abilities with proficiency in data interpretation and Excel-based reporting.

- Sound credit judgment with the ability to make timely, well-reasoned decisions and structure mitigants for complex deals.

- Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain decision rationales.

- Proficiency in financial statement analysis, bureau data, and banking transactions; familiarity with automated and digital decisioning.

- 5+ years’ experience in credit risk, credit assessment, or lending rol

title: Senior Quantitative Modeller/Developer - Stochastic Simulations in Power Markets
description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence - all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly - all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a  Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Energy Products practice are looking for an experienced Senior Quantitative Modeller/Developer to join the team  - Stochastic Simulations in Power Markets.  

The CORAL team within our Energy Products practice develops the modelling platform that underpins Baringa's market analysis, valuation, and optimisation capabilities across European energy markets. We build production-grade software used by our consultants, analysts, SaaS developers, and clients to model power markets, simulate market prices, optimise assets, and deliver long-term market insights.
Our work spans statistical and stochastic models, optimisation, internal/external data, and AI-enabled tooling. We combine software engineering, quantitative methods, and energy market expertise to create scalable solutions that support both advisory engagements and productised offerings across Baringa globally.
As our modelling capabilities continue to expand, we are looking for an experienced quantitative modeller to lead the development and evolution of our stochastic simulation framework and associated market modelling methodologies.

What you will be doing

• Lead the design, development, calibration, and validation of Baringa's stochastic simulation models across power, gas, LNG, and other commodity markets.

• Develop advanced modelling methodologies including mean-reverting jump diffusion (MRJD), two-factor, and multi-factor stochastic models.

• Improve the representation of commodity price behaviour, volatility, market regimes, and structural market change within our modelling framework.

• Combine liquid horizon market data with Baringa's long-term fundamental market outlooks to create stochastic simulations that are consistent with our scenario-based simulations.

• Research and implement new quantitative approaches for modelling uncertainty, asset valuation, risk assessment, and market behaviour.

• Work closely with market modelling specialists, advisory teams, and clients to ensure models remain relevant, credible, and aligned with commercial decision-making.

• Partner with software engineers to ensure modelling methodologies are implemented as robust, maintainable, and scalable production software.

• Drive model calibration, validation, benchmarking, and ongoing performance monitoring.

• Communicate complex quantitative concepts clearly to technical, commercial, and executive audiences.

• Contribute to Baringa's thought leadership in quantitative energy

title: Growth (Russian speaking)
description:
ABOUT COLUMN

For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand - builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.

At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!

THE OPPORTUNITY

Column's Growth team is focused on managing our highly strategic customer relationships. As a member of the Growth team, you’ll be responsible for building and overseeing all aspects of our customer management while acting as a trusted partner, advisor and advocate for a wide variety of customers. You will also be in charge of designing and implementing the strategy, processes, and content needed to help us scale this key function.

This role has a unique international focus, helping build one of Column's most strategic expansion initiatives from the ground up. At least have of your work will be dedicated to building and managing partnerships with banks across the CIS and Eastern Europe. The rest of your time will go to working with Column's core fintech partners.

Column's Growth team is not your typical Customer Success or Account Management team in that Column is a critical, often existential, partner for our customers, our customer relationships are deeply collaborative and complex, and each customer contributes meaningfully to our revenue. We're therefore looking for team members who are analytical, demonstrate great critical thinking, and have experience managing very strategic relationships.

This role is highly cross-functional and collaborative, partnering closely with Column’s Executive, Solutions Engineering, Sales, Compliance, and Correspondent Banking teams to ensure customers are onboarded smoothly, that we can anticipate and address both issues and opportunities for growth, and that these relationships are healthy and mutually beneficial. You’ll also represent the voice of the customer to help inform Column's strategy, including the product roadmap, go-to-market motions and more.

Success in this role also means having a desire to become an expert on the Financial Technology space and on how companies partner with Column (our customers include many key industry players such as Brex and Carta).

This role reports to the Head of Growth and is an in-person role, where you’ll be expected to work out of our San Francisco Presidio-based office 3+ days a week.

- Manage all aspects of a customer’s relationship with Column, from onboarding and implementation to ongoing management and expansion of the account

title: OTC Trader
description:
About the Role
We're hiring an OTC Trader to manage day-to-day trading activities across String 's OTC desk, covering fiat currencies and stablecoins.
This is a hands-on trading role for someone comfortable sourcing competitive prices from liquidity providers, distributing daily rates, quoting counterparties, and executing trades.
You'll work closely with our treasury and commercial teams to ensure trades are competitively priced, efficiently executed, and commercially profitable.
The role is focused on managing trading activity and growing transaction volumes from existing counterparties rather than originating new customers. You'll also help expand our network of liquidity providers to improve pricing and execution capabilities.

What you'll do
FX Pricing & Liquidity Sourcing

• Source and compare live FX and stablecoin rates across banks, OTC desks, and liquidity providers.

• Identify the best executable prices based on spreads, available liquidity, transaction size, and settlement requirements.

• Maintain relationships with existing liquidity providers and identify new pricing and liquidity opportunities.

• Monitor market movements, liquidity conditions, and pricing trends across supported currencies.

• Negotiate competitive rates while maintaining String 's target trading margins.

Trading & Execution

• Provide indicative and firm quotes to counterparties across USD, USDT, USDC, GHS, NGN, and other supported currencies.

• Manage trade execution from pricing and negotiation through booking and confirmation.

• Maintain accurate trade records, including transaction amounts, exchange rates, spreads, and counterparty details.

• Coordinate with treasury to confirm funding availability and settlement arrangements before committing to trades.

• Monitor outstanding trades and resolve pricing or execution-related issues.

Counterparty Management & Trading Activity

• Distribute daily FX and stablecoin rates to existing counterparties through approved communication channels.

• Respond promptly to pricing enquiries and requests for quotes.

• Maintain active relationships with counterparties to encourage recurring trading activity.

• Follow up on outstanding quotes and identify opportunities to increase trading volumes.

• Reactivate dormant counterparties and strengthen engagement with existing trading relationships.

Liquidity Provider & Counterparty Onboarding

• Identify and establish relationships with new OTC desks, market makers, and liquidity providers.

• Evaluate potential liquidity partners based on pricing competitiveness, execution reliability, settlement capabilities, and available liquidity.

• Coordinate onboarding of new liquidity providers with compliance and treasury teams.

• Maintain an active network of trading counterparties to support competitive pricing and execution.

Trading Operations & Risk Management

• Monitor trading spreads, execution costs, and net desk revenue.

• Ensure trades are executed within approved pricing, exposure, and risk limits.

• Maintain accurate trading records and support daily trade reconciliation with treasury.

• Escalate unusual market conditions, pricing discrepancies, and execution risks.

• Prepare daily trading activity reports covering volumes, margins, executed trades, and outstanding transactions.

What we're looking for

• Approximately 2-6 years of experience in FX trading, OTC trading, treasury dealing, brokerage, or institutional digital asset trading.

• Practical experience sourcing FX or stablecoin liquidity and executing transactions.

• Strong understanding of foreign exchange markets, bid/offer spreads, pricing, and trade execution.

• Familiarity with stablecoins, particularly USDT and USDC.

• Experience working with OTC desks, liquidity providers, brokers, or institutional counterparties.

• Ability to negotiate competitive pricing and manage multiple live transactions.

• Strong numerical and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail.

title: Director Sales (all genders)
description:
We're building a sales team that wins, and we're looking for the leaders who'll make it happen.

As Director Sales at Lio, you're a true player-coach. You build, coach and lead a team of 6-8 Account Executives, and when a big deal is on the line, you're right there in the room helping close it. You don't chase a quota of your own. You own your team's number, and the goal is ambitious: hit the target together, then double it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead your team to its number. You help your team hit its target and build the pipeline and habits that let it grow from there.

- Be there when deals need you. You join calls, visit customers on site and help close seven-figure opportunities. When the usual playbook isn't enough, you get creative.

- Know what's real in your forecast. You're curious about every deal and look into it yourself, so you and your team always know where you stand.

- Take ownership. If a deal stalls, you reach out to the champion yourself. If it needs a workshop, you're happy to run it. You do what the deal needs.

- Help your reps grow. You make coaching, training and deal reviews part of the team's week, and nothing motivates you more than seeing your AEs succeed.

- Bring our way of selling to life. You know the product well and sell in an inquisitive, consultative and educative way, so your team learns it from you.

WHO YOU ARE

- You've carried a quota, closed complex B2B or enterprise deals, and still enjoy selling.

- You've led a sales team, had a first management experience, or feel ready to take that step. Many of our future managers start as AEs at Lio, get to know how we sell, and then grow into leadership.

- You're entrepreneurial and find creative ways to reach a goal.

- You like to check things for yourself and ask good questions, including of your own team.

- You love learning and are excited to adapt to how we sell rather than bringing a ready-made playbook.

- Building a team excites you more than your own quota.

THIS MIGHT NOT BE THE RIGHT FIT IF…

- you'd prefer to focus purely on people management and step away from deals.

- you'd rather stick to one proven playbook than adapt it.

- you'd rather keep your own quota than build a team.

- you prefer to rely on your team's forecast without digging into it.

WHY NOW

Our Go-To-Market team will grow significantly over the next year. You'd join early enough to shape how we lead sales, at a point where you can already see it working. Together with our sales leadership, you'll build your team and help define what great sales management looks like at Lio.

If you're hungry to build a team that outperforms every target, to turn good reps into great ones, and to win the biggest deals together, we want to hear from you.

title: Growth Marketing Lead
description:
About the Role
Lead growth marketing strategy for a performance marketing and advertising technology company. This client-facing role connects paid media, creative development, and analytics to help accounts scale efficiently.
What You'll Do

• Manage and optimize paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Google, overseeing substantial annual budgets.

• Lead client relationships through regular meetings, strategy sessions, and quarterly business reviews.

• Develop growth strategies that integrate creative performance with paid media buying.

• Translate campaign and creative performance data into clear recommendations for clients and internal teams.

• Improve media efficiency through funnel strategy, signal quality, offer testing, and measurement.

• Partner with creative teams and media buyers to develop effective content and scale campaigns.

What We're Looking For

• Four to eight years of hands-on paid media experience, ideally in an agency or consumer app environment.

• Deep expertise in Meta advertising, with experience managing campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Google.

• Experience independently managing paid media accounts with seven-figure annual budgets.

• Strong client relationship, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills, including experience leading quarterly business reviews.

• Analytical skills and experience using performance data, KPIs, and metrics to shape strategic recommendations.

• Experience integrating creative performance with media buying and optimizing campaigns through funnel strategy, offer testing, and measurement.

• Mobile advertising measurement knowledge, including SKAN, AEM, and mobile measurement partners, is preferred.

Compensation & Benefits
Base salary range: $130,000 to $175,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.
Location
On-site in New York, New York.
